_help: Single source for every price, name and placeholder. Empty/null or [bracketed] values are never rendered (their line or section is hidden). provisional:true shows the 'Estimate' tag. Legal-line placeholders are kept for Ben's wording but hidden while flags.showLegalLine is false.
_publicHelp: public:false keeps noindex on every page and robots.txt blocking all crawlers. public:true drops noindex (404 stays noindex), robots.txt allows crawling and points to /sitemap.xml. sitemap.xml and canonical links always use siteUrl.

prices._note: Every £ figure on the site comes from here. In text, {key} is replaced by that price’s figure (e.g. {check} -> £50) and {key+} by the full price with its prefix and unit (e.g. {domain+} -> about £10 a year). {creditDays}, {changesMinutes} and {email} are filled in too.

items.a: No VAT is added to our prices.

No. The only extras are paid straight to other providers: your domain name ({domain+}), hosting and email if you want it, all in your own name. With a New website or Website refresh, there’s no monthly bill from us.

check.title: Website & brand check
text: We look at your home page, two other pages and your social accounts from the outside, then send you a written list of fixes.
The {check} credit comes off any build, whether a refresh or a new site.
finePrint: Checks use only publicly visible information. We won’t log in, scan for weaknesses or try to break in. This isn’t a full security audit or penetration test.
The {check} credit lasts {creditDays} days from when we send your report. It can be used once, against any build, and has no cash value.
